commonSequence: Start the above matchup. Wait for the Draw Phase Response window with Hornet Drones and no chain.
Press No, do not activate (first empty window). Wait for opponent Fuwalos CL1.
Press No, do not chain to Mulcharmy Fuwalos.
At the next Draw empty window press No, do not activate once more.
At the following Draw empty window press Hornet Drones Yes, activate. Wait for token summon and Roze optional-effect question.
Choose No on Use Sky Striker Ace - Roze’s effect?. Let empty automatic windows finish; reach Main Phase 1.
Open View actions. Click the FIRST Special Summon · Sky Striker Ace - Kagari (three Kagari copies are offered).
Stop at Choose Link materials; only Use · Sky Striker Ace Token and Cancel are offered.
Click Use · Sky Striker Ace Token. Allow auto-placement; wait for empty-chain prompt offering Kagari and Roze.
Click Activate this effect: Sky Striker Ace - Kagari, Recover a Sky Striker Spell.
Stop at Choose a card to add to hand, Hornet Drones in GY, required 1. This is the activation target, not a cost or resolving search.
Select Hornet Drones then Confirm. Journal now records Target · Hornet Drones, and chain response offers Roze.
Choose Yes, chain Roze. At the next own response window to CL2, choose No, do not chain (Widow Anchor).
Allow auto-placement during Resolve Chain 2. Stop at Choose battle position: Face-up Attack / Face-up Defence for Roze.

cases.notes: Built CL2 Roze above CL1 Kagari, but Kagari target was selected before resolution; do not mislabel that as CL1 asking during resolution. No proven Deck selection after CL2 in this bounded traversal.
No selectable activation cost reached. Fuwalos discard was automatic from the AI hand, not a player cost-selection fixture. Do not call Hornet or Linkage resolution actions costs.
